t: Fixed missing error messages in SSO OIDC error responses by mapping OAuth2 error_description field to the standard Message field.  Issue was raised in `#2216 <https://github.com/boto/botocore/issues/2216>`__.
This release includes exception definition and documentation updates.
This release adds AwsAdditionalDetails in the CreateTokenWithIAM API response.
Updated request parameters for PKCE support.
Documentation updates for the IAM Identity Center OIDC CLI Reference.
Updated required request parameters on IAM Identity Center's OIDC CreateToken action.
Documentation updates to reflect service rename - AWS IAM Identity Center (successor to AWS Single Sign-On)
Update sso-oidc client to latest version
